description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger covers DE + EN phrasings for code-graph-answerable STRUCTURE questions — callers, references, import graph, symbol change-impact, how two symbols connect. Should-not-trigger covers the near-miss neighbours (blast-radius impact narrative, source-discovery structural evidence, the refactor executor, deep codebase audit, content/semantic grep) whose vocabulary overlaps.

queries.q: who calls PaymentService::refund? build me the call graph
where is this helper actually used across the repo?
what breaks if I change the signature of this method — show me every referencing symbol
wer ruft diese Funktion auf und was importiert sie?
how do these two classes connect — is there a path from the controller to the mailer?
before I edit this shared trait, list every call site, queue worker, event consumer and migration it touches with file:line
